```{=html}
<section class="funding-page">

<style>
@import url('[https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Comfortaa:wght@700&display=swap](https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Comfortaa:wght@700&display=swap)');

/* =====================================
   FOND ET DÉCORATIONS
===================================== */

html, body, #quarto-content {
  background-color: #F4F0E8 !important;
}

.funding-page {
  font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;
  color: #293747;
  background: transparent;
  padding: 35px 22px;
  max-width: 1200px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  position: relative;
  isolation: isolate;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

.funding-page * {
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

/* LAVANDE À DROITE */

.lavande-filigrane {
  position: fixed;
  right: 15px;
  bottom: 10px;
  width: 190px;
  height: auto;
  opacity: 0.17;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: -1;
}

/* ÉPI DE BLÉ À GAUCHE */

.ble-filigrane {
  position: fixed;
  left: 8px;
  bottom: 15px;
  width: 175px;
  height: auto;
  opacity: 0.19;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: -1;
}

/* =====================================
   EN-TÊTE
===================================== */

.funding-header {
  position: relative;
  text-align: center;
  margin-bottom: 38px;
  padding: 26px 12px 10px;
  overflow: visible;
}

.sac-argent-filigrane {
  position: absolute;
  left: 50%;
  top: 25%;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
  width: 210px;
  height: auto;
  opacity: 0.14;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: -1;
}

.funding-eyebrow {
  color: #9b784b;
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 2px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.funding-header h1 {
  color: #26394d;
  font-family: 'Comfortaa', sans-serif;
  font-size: clamp(32px, 5vw, 46px);
  line-height: 1.3;
  margin: 0 0 14px;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.funding-header p {
  color: #59636e;
  font-size: 18px;
  line-height: 1.7;
  max-width: 760px;
  margin: 0 auto;
}

/* =====================================
   CONTENU FINANCEMENT
===================================== */

.funding {
  max-width: 960px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 0;
  background: transparent;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 0;
  color: #293747;
  box-shadow: none;
}

/* =====================================
   COÛT GLOBAL
===================================== */

.funding-total {
  background: #ffffff;
  padding: 22px;
  border-radius: 9px;
  border: 1px solid #e5e0d8;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.funding-total > span {
  font-size: 11px;
  letter-spacing: 1.4px;
  color: #94764b;
  font-weight: 700;
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
}

.funding-total > strong {
  display: block;
  font-size: 36px;
  color: #26394d;
  margin: 8px 0 18px;
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
}

.funding-bar {
  display: flex;
  height: 15px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  overflow: hidden;
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
}

.commune-part {
  width: 25%;
  background: #344e68;
}

.drac-part {
  width: 75%;
  background: #b9b9b0;
}

.funding-legend {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 10px;
  margin-top: 12px;
  font-size: 12px;
  color: #555;
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
}

/* ARGENT QUI S'ENVOLE */

.money-flying {
  position: absolute;
  right: 25px;
  top: 5px;
  width: 115px;
  height: 105px;
  opacity: 0.8;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 0;
}

@media (max-width: 560px) {
  .money-flying {
    width: 75px;
    height: 75px;
    right: 8px;
    top: 8px;
    opacity: 0.55;
  }
}

/* =====================================
   RÉPARTITION DES FINANCEMENTS
===================================== */

.funding-flow {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 14px;
  margin-top: 18px;
}

.funding-card {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 13px;
  padding: 18px;
  background: #ffffff;
  border: 1px solid #e5e0d8;
  border-radius: 9px;
}

.institution-logo {
  flex: 0 0 43px;
  height: 43px;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  background: #f1eee7;
  border-radius: 50%;
  font-size: 23px;
}

/* DRAPEAU FRANÇAIS */

.french-flag {
  display: flex;
  overflow: hidden;
  border-radius: 50%;
  width: 43px;
  height: 43px;
  padding: 0;
  flex: 0 0 43px;
}

.french-flag span {
  flex: 1;
  height: 100%;
}

.french-flag span:nth-child(1) {
  background: #002395;
}

.french-flag span:nth-child(2) {
  background: #ffffff;
}

.french-flag span:nth-child(3) {
  background: #ed2939;
}

.funding-card h3 {
  font-family: Georgia, serif;
  font-size: 19px;
  color: #26394d;
  margin: 2px 0 8px;
  line-height: 1.4;
}

.funding-card strong {
  font-size: 25px;
  color: #344e68;
}

.funding-card p {
  font-size: 13px;
  line-height: 1.5;
  color: #777;
  margin-bottom: 0;
}

/* =====================================
   DOCUMENT OFFICIEL
===================================== */

.funding-reference {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 15px;
  margin-top: 18px;
  padding: 17px;
  background: #f7f5f1;
  border: 1px solid #e5e0d8;
  border-left: 4px solid #b49363;
  border-radius: 9px;
  color: #252525;
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: background .2s, border-color .2s;
}

.funding-reference:hover {
  background: #f0ece3;
  border-color: #c5b18e;
}

.reference-icon {
  flex: 0 0 42px;
  height: 42px;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  background: #eee8dc;
  border-radius: 9px;
  font-size: 23px;
}

.reference-content {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 5px;
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
}

.reference-label {
  color: #94764b;
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 1.1px;
}

.reference-content strong {
  color: #26394d;
  font-size: 16px;
}

.reference-description {
  color: #596575;
  font-size: 13px;
  line-height: 1.5;
}

.reference-meeting {
  color: #687585;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-style: italic;
}

.reference-action {
  color: #94764b;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 700;
  margin-top: 4px;
}

.reference-arrow {
  color: #94764b;
  font-size: 20px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

/* =====================================
   DESTINATION DE LA COMMANDE
===================================== */

.funding-destination {
  text-align: center;
  margin-top: 20px;
}

.funding-destination > span {
  display: block;
  font-size: 28px;
  color: #a8895d;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
}

.funding-destination > div {
  background: #344e68;
  color: white;
  padding: 20px;
  border-radius: 9px;
}

.funding-destination small {
  color: #d6dce2;
  font-size: 11px;
  letter-spacing: 1.4px;
}

.funding-destination strong {
  display: block;
  font-size: 19px;
  margin: 8px 0;
}

.funding-destination p {
  font-size: 13px;
  margin: 0;
  color: #e1e6eb;
}

/* =====================================
   RESPONSIVE
===================================== */

@media (max-width: 750px) {

  .funding-page {
    padding: 25px 12px;
  }

  .sac-argent-filigrane {
    width: 165px;
    top: 30%;
    opacity: 0.12;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 600px) {

  .lavande-filigrane {
    width: 110px;
    right: -12px;
    bottom: 5px;
    opacity: 0.12;
  }

  .ble-filigrane {
    width: 105px;
    left: -15px;
    bottom: 5px;
    opacity: 0.13;
  }
}

@media(max-width: 560px) {

  .funding-flow {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .funding-legend {
    font-size: 10px;
  }

  .funding-total {
    padding: 17px;
  }

  .funding-total > strong {
    font-size: 32px;
  }

  .funding-reference {
    padding: 13px;
    gap: 10px;
  }

  .reference-icon {
    flex-basis: 35px;
    height: 35px;
    font-size: 20px;
  }

  .reference-label {
    font-size: 9px;
  }

  .funding-destination > div {
    padding: 17px;
  }
}

/* =====================================
   IMPRESSION
===================================== */

@media print {

  .lavande-filigrane,
  .ble-filigrane,
  .sac-argent-filigrane {
    display: none;
  }

}
</style>
```
